user.title: Carnot limit basis
user.description: Which temperatures define the Carnot limit. Water: flow and outdoor temperature. Refrigerant: condensing and evaporating temperature. The default calibration comes from one unit; see the README.

entities.title: Source entities
entities.description: Entities of the heat pump firmware. Matching entities of lg-therma-v-esphome-modbus are suggested.

data.power: Electric power of the heat pump

error.same_water_entities: Flow and return temperature must be different entities.
error.same_carnot_entities: The warm and the cold temperature must be different entities.

init.title: Calibration
init.description: Carnot efficiency rises linearly from the low to the high value between the two water delta T points. Auxiliary power is subtracted from the electric power before the COP is applied.

data.efficiency_low: Carnot efficiency at low delta T
data.efficiency_high: Carnot efficiency at high delta T

error.invalid_delta_t: The low delta T must be below the high delta T.
